headword: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}

definitions.explanation: Travel organized for a group of people, typically with a set itinerary, guide, and group pricing. Includes company trips, school excursions, and package tours.

examples.japanese: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}で{北海道|ほっかいどう}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Hokkaido on a group tour.

examples.japanese: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}は{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}より{安|やす}いことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Group tours are often cheaper than individual travel.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}で{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}に{一泊|いっぱく}した。
examples.english: We stayed one night at a hot spring inn on a company group trip.

notes:
Composed of {団体|だんたい} (group, organization) + {旅行|りょこう} (travel). Covers any organized group travel — company trips ({社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}), school excursions ({修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}), and commercial package tours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}に{参加|さんか}する: to join a group tour
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}を{企画|きかく}する: to plan a group tour
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}{割引|わりびき}: group travel discount
- {海外|かいがい}{団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}: overseas group tour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}: individual travel — self-planned travel without a group
- パッケージツアー: package tour — a commercial tour product with set itinerary, often used for overseas trips
- {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}: company trip — specifically for employees of a company
- {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}: school excursion — a multi-day educational trip organized by schools
